glen.follow:
function MakeUnitFollow takes unit u, unit target, integer time returns nothing
    local timer t = CreateTimer()
    local integer r = time * 25
    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( u, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow1"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( target, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow2"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
    call SaveIntegerBJ( r, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow3"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
    call TimerStart(t, 0.04, true, function MakeUnitFollow_Sub)
endfunction
glen.follow_tick:
function MakeUnitFollow_Sub takes nothing returns nothing
    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
    local hashtable data = GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ()
    local integer key = GetHandleId(t)
    local unit follower = LoadUnitHandle(data, key, StringHash("Follow1"))
    local unit target = LoadUnitHandle(data, key, StringHash("Follow2"))
    local integer remaining = LoadInteger(data, key, StringHash("Follow3"))
    if remaining >= 0 and IsUnitAliveBJ(target) and IsUnitAliveBJ(follower) then
        call SetUnitPosition(follower, GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target))
        call SetUnitFacing(follower, GetUnitFacing(target))
        call SaveInteger(data, key, StringHash("Follow3"), remaining-1)
    else
        call RemoveUnit(follower)
        call FlushChildHashtable(data, key)
        call PauseTimer(t)
        call DestroyTimer(t)
    endif
    set follower = null
    set target = null
    set data = null
    set t = null
endfunction
